_meta.purpose: Maps anonymous multi-agent IDs (agent_01 .. agent_12) to creator-readable labels. Loaded by engine/observer/identity_resolver.py as Stage 5 enrichment input.
rules: This map names *who is who* — it does NOT prescribe what they will do.
Plots emerge from the simulation. Story Threads are mined from the data, not from this map.
Edit freely: change names, archetypes, roles. The mining pipeline reads the map post-hoc; changing labels does not change which threads emerge.
If this file is deleted, the resolver falls back to archetype inference from observer initial state — IDs stay as 'agent_03' but get an archetype tag.
_meta.edit_freedom: Names below are example labels chosen for the peter_scarcity_baseline anchor. They are not engine-validated — agent_03 does not 'have to' be Peter; another reading of the same simulation could call agent_03 something else.
